japanese-kana.swsh: からだを　ぶつけて　こうげき。 ぼうぎょが　たかいほど あたえる　ダメージが　ふえる。

korean.swsh: 몸을 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 방어가 높을수록 주는 데미지가 올라간다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 用身體撞向對手進行攻擊。 自己的防禦越高， 給予對手的傷害越大。

french.swsh: Le lanceur utilise son corps pour attaquer sa cible. Plus la Défense du lanceur est élevée, plus les dégâts infligés sont importants.

german.swsh: Der Anwender greift mit seinem ganzen Körper an. Je höher seine Verteidigung ist, desto mehr Schaden richtet er an.

spanish.swsh: El usuario usa el cuerpo para lanzar su ataque e infligir un daño directamente proporcional a su Defensa.

italian.swsh: Chi la usa schiaccia il bersaglio con il suo corpo. Più la sua Difesa è alta, maggiori sono i danni inflitti.

english.swsh: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.
english.la: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.
english.sv: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

japanese.swsh: 体を　ぶつけて　攻撃。 防御が　高いほど 与える　ダメージが　増える。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 用身体撞向对手进行攻击。 防御越高， 给予的伤害就越高。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: El usuario usa el cuerpo para lanzar su ataque e infligir un daño directamente proporcional a su Defensa.

effect.full: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.
effect.shortEffect: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.
